tools.name: search_linof_docs
tools.description: Search Linof's public documentation (what Linof does, how a film is made, pricing, guides, policies) by keywords. Use it first when a question is about Linof and you do not yet know which page answers it; then read a page in full with fetch_linof_doc.

tools.name: fetch_linof_doc
tools.description: Read one of Linof's public markdown docs in full, by its path ("/pricing.md") or its https://linof.ai URL. Use it after search_linof_docs, or directly for /index.md (the product overview) and /pricing.md.

tools.name: get_linof_pricing
tools.description: Get the prices Linof sells at right now: the Starter, Standard and Premium plans, their packages in every currency, top-ups and the free trial, read live from Linof's pricing service. Use it for any question about cost, rather than quoting a price from memory.
